messages.subject: Apps not working?
parts:
Hi,

I had a couple of apps running on glimmer and they don't seem to be running now. Any ideas on what the issues might be?
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/vivekpatil/TotCrime/
http://glimmer.rstudio.com/vivekpatil/indiacrimeshiny

Thanks very much,
Vivek

On Mon, Sep 30, 2013 at 3:27 PM, Joe Cheng <j...@rstudio.com> wrote:
We're working on a more general feature that you might be able to build on to accomplish this--stay tuned...


On Mon, Sep 30, 2013 at 10:14 AM, Alan Eng <alanf...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello,

My team at the company I work for would find it very useful to have emails periodically delivered to our inboxes that shows a given app at its current state. We're basically looking for a snapshot of the app currently running on Shiny server and have it sent to our inboxes, perhaps on a fixed schedule.

Is there any option to do that at the moment, or is that a feature that can be considered for the enterprise version?

Thank you!

Alan

messages.subject: Re: Apps not working?
parts:
Yes, they do work now. Thanks for checking. Linking back to an earlier discussion on the spark server multiple user limitation at https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/shiny-discuss/class$20montana/shiny-discuss/__jfiBijS4Y/k3OnIiM5M6UJ, are there limitations on the glimmer server usage by multiple users in this version of the server that might result in graying out of screens? Thanks very much for this excellent service. I'm a huge fan.

Vivek

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Apps not working?
parts:
The SLA you have with us for these free accounts is effectively that the server may go down at any time. Our current limitation of 200 concurrent users on any app on Glimmer/Spark is really an upper bound that we don't expect many apps to hit, and we reserve the right to change that number at any time, as necessary to keep the servers going.

As for how long these free beta accounts will last, we really do not know at this point. We also do not know how long we will continue to let people sign up for new accounts. If it's critical for you to know the answer, that might be a good sign that you want to be running your own server. :)
